real_defects.issue: sensitiveData missed a card number typed with its security code or expiry after it ('4111 1111 1111 1111 123', '... 12 29'): the greedy 13-19 digit match swallowed the extra digits and failed Luhn, so the agent searched and answered instead of handing off with its do-not-send warning; with a model configured (model.mjs answer()) the raw question, card number included, went to the LLM provider. The stored log was already masked by store.mjs redact(). Also missed SSNs written with spaces. Fixed: every stretch of whole digit groups holding 13-19 digits is tried; SSN accepts a consistent space or dash.

sentences() split a numbered step '1. Open Settings' into '1.' and 'Open Settings', so an extract cut at a step started or ended on a bare '1.' and the newline join for steps never fired. Fixed with a lookbehind that does not split after a line-start step marker.

stem() maps a word and its inflections to different stems ('rate'->'rate' but 'rates'->'rat'; 'ship' vs 'shipping'->'shipp'; 'code' vs 'codes'->'cod'; 'policy' vs 'policies'), so a non-final query word of 3 stemmed letters never matches the other form (repro: KB title 'Shipping rate', query 'rates shipping' -> matchedAll false). A candidate fix (es only after s/x/z/ch/sh, fold trailing e and y->i, undouble after -ing/-ed) was measured on the BANKING77 dev split only: right answers 77/760/1030 -> 78/791/1011 at 0/10/40 past questions (wrong 4/40/54 -> 4/40/53), mixed, so it was not shipped. Shipping it changes support-agent's published test-split table (a fourth scoring, to note in fixtures/banking77/README.md), the DEFAULT_CALIBRATION* constants (refit with benchmark.mjs --defaults), eval.test.mjs and page.test.mjs pins, and the numbers in README, index.html, llms.txt and the how-to page. Worth doing with a help-center (not banking) eval set that shows the gain.
real_defects.blocked: a help-center (not banking) eval set that shows the stemmer fix gains; BANKING77 alone measured it as mixed
